title: Exact streaming incremental byte-pair tokenization via linear-time rank-ordered DFS two-interval compilation
coding_guidance: Edit only model.py; never modify eval.py/data.py/task_spec.json. Preserve IncrementalBPE(vocab,rules,config), append(byte) returning last token ID, and tokens() returning all current prefix token IDs. Exact priority-ranked BPE at every prefix. CRITICAL DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: (1) Do NOT implement any runtime memoization/dictionary cache (no acceptance_cache). (2) Compile each merge token's valid predecessor region in the rank-ordered SufSucTree into at most TWO half-open DFS intervals (L[a], L[a]+1, q_t, R[a]) in STRICT O(M+R) LINEAR TIME via a single forward rank sweep maintaining cutoff[s(t)] = R[t] BEFORE reading cutoff.get(p(t), L[p(t)]+1) (avoiding O(R log Delta) binary searches while guaranteeing strict equal-rank exclusion when p(t)==s(t)). (3) Provide a fast valid(t, n) method using the precompiled intervals so direct predicate microbenchmarks and fallback paths benefit from O(1) interval checks, while inlining the two-interval check inside append(byte) using a flat 1D integer array or compact pre-unpacked per-state tuples, dense 256-way flat automaton transitions, and an O(1) single-byte atomic fast-path bypass. (4) Support clean orthogonal config switches: acceptance_mode in ['intervals','sets','pointer'], flat_transitions (bool, default True), atomic_fastpath (bool, default True), certified_regions (bool, default False).
metric_description: Randomized interleaved paired streaming latency (ms per 10KB) with Student-t 95% CI, forced depth-D predicate microbenchmark, cache-free mechanism isolation, deep-forest scaling sweep (R up to 512, D up to 36), and tracemalloc peak memory.
